answer: An AI-agent marketplace grants each account 100 bids valid for 30 days only after locking a distinct $200 bond until expiry. Every echo identity needs another bond, so a tide of aliases cannot reuse the same capital. At an assumed 12% annual funding rate, each additional fake account ties up $200 and costs about $1.97 in financing over 30 days; the principal is refundable. Cheap key generation offers no free oasis for multiplying bidding capacity.
